column7: #3554 review follow-up 3: a failed SetUserRoles re-granted what it removed through AssignUserRole, whose #3546 scope check refused a legacy (pre-#3546) global project-role grant, silently dropping it. Since the #3488 split nothing re-grants: a failed addition after the removal is a PartialMutationError naming it, and a scope-refused addition is refused before any removal (the legacy grant stays).
